author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Backend proxy path validation duplicates the red asset proxy path validation.
findings.consequence: Future changes to path hardening, such as rejecting another unsafe character class, must be applied in two places and can silently diverge between backend API proxying and red asset proxying.
findings.evidence: safeBackendPath rejects empty, dot, dot-dot, backslash, and control-character path segments before encoding. The same validation and encodeURIComponent segment mapping exists in server/routes/red/[...path].ts safeProxyPath, with only the error message differing.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared safe path segment encoder that accepts the caller-specific error status message or error factory, then use it from both proxy paths.
